properties.content:

Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: HYDROGEN PEROXIDE SOLUTION (>8%
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: ADM COCOA
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 2000 gallons
GLOUCESTER COUNTY HAZ-MAT REPORTING AN EXPLOSION FROM A TANK ON THE PROPERTY OF ADM COCO. MATERIAL IS >50% HYDROGEN PEROXIDE. H2O2 IS AN AQUEOUS SOLUTION. HYDROGEN PEROXIDE DIFFER FROM THOSE OF THE PURE MATERIAL, REFLECTING THE EFFECTS OF HYDROGEN BONDING BETWEEN WATER AND HYDROGEN PEROXIDE. HYDROGEN PEROXIDE AND WATER FORM A EUTECTIC MIXTURE, EXHIBITING FREEZING-POINT DEPRESSION. PURE WATER MELTS AND FREEZES AT APPROXIMATELY 273 K, AND PURE HYDROGEN PEROXIDE JUST 0.4 K BELOW THAT, BUT A 50% (BY VOLUME) SOLUTION MELTS AND FREEZES AT 221 K.[5] PURE HYDROGEN PEROXIDE HAS A PH OF 6.2; THUS IT IS CONSIDERED TO BE A WEAK ACID. THE PH CAN BE AS LOW AS 4.5 WHEN DILUTED AT APPROXIMATELY 60%. HYDROGEN PEROXIDE DECOMPOSES DISPROPORTIONATES) EXOTHERMICALLY INTO WATER AND OXYGEN GAS SPONTANEOUSLY: 2 H2O2 ? 2 H2O + O2 REPORTS ARE THAT THERE WAS A VIOLENT REACTION AND A SUBSTANTIAL SPILL. MATERIAL REACTING THROUGHOUT THE SPILL AREA. EVACUATION ON-GOING R26 AND 24 IN ROUTE TO THE SITE.

properties.content:
Report Details

Incident Time: 2026-07-06 06:00:00
Nearest City: Aldridge, IL
Location2: UPPER MISSISSIPPI RIVER: MILE MARKER 78
Incident Type: VESSEL
Medium Affected: WATER
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 37.558383, -89.470095 (Approximated from locality)
Report DescriptionINITIAL: - THE TUG CHRISTOPHER D. WISLON STRUCK A FLOATING LOG AND EXPERIENCED A PROPULSION FAILURE NEAR MILE MARKER 78 ON THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI RIVER. - THE TUG WAS TRANSPORTING ROCK AND GRAIN BARGES IN A 5X5 CONFIGURATION THAT BECAME STUCK ON THE RIVERBANK FOLLOWING THE PROPULSION FAILURE. - INSPECTED TOWING VESSEL (ITV) CAPT TONY ICE ARRIVED ON SCENE TO ASSIST BUT COULD NOT FREE ALL THE BARGES. - LIGHTERING EQUIPMENT HAS BEEN REQUESTED WITH NO CURRENT ETA. - THE INCIDENT OCCURRED IN A ONE-WAY TRAFFIC AREA AND THERE ARE 02 UPBOUND AND 02 DOWNBOUND VESSELS IN THE QUEUE. - THERE IS NO ESTIMATED TIME FOR THE RIVER TO REOPEN. UPDATE 01: - A RECEIVER BARGE FOR LIGHTERING OPERATIONS IS SCHEDULED TO BE ON SCENE AT 2300Z TO ATTEMPT TO REFLOAT THE STUCK BARGE. - ONE WAY TRAFFIC IS NOW ALLOWED WHEN ACTIVE WORK IS NOT OCCURRING ON THE GROUNDED BARGE. - TRAFFIC IS BEING COORDINATED THROUGH THE ITV CHRISTOPHER WILSON. UPDATE 02: - HEARTLAND DISTRICT REPORTS THE LIGHTERING CREW IS ON SCENE. - LIGHTERING OPERATIONS ARE PLANNED TO COMMENCE AT 07JUL2026 1200Z. - THERE IS NO QUEUE OF VESSELS.
